ayahs.en: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh
ayahs.e2: ˹At least˺ for ˹the favour of˺ making Quraysh habitually secure—

ayahs.en: Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer
ayahs.e2: secure in their trading caravan ˹to Yemen˺ in the winter and ˹Syria˺ in the summer—

ayahs.en: Let them worship the Lord of this House
ayahs.e2: let them worship the Lord of this ˹Sacred˺ House

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِيٓ أَطۡعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعࣲ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنۡ خَوۡفِۭ
ayahs.en: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear
ayahs.e2: Who has fed them against hunger and made them secure against fear
ayahs.tr: Allazi at'amahum min ju'inw-wa-aamana hum min khawf
